humanTitle: People cannot reach help when a booking has already gone wrong
whoItAffects: Android users in the United States, across three app versions.

build.proposition: A support path that does not run inside the failing app.
specifics: Send a link that opens support in the browser, outside the broken session
Carry the booking reference in the link so nothing is retyped
Start with the freeze reviewers hit when opening chat
build.limitation: Support is built into the app precisely to keep the person inside it.

start.proposition: A booking assistant that holds your references outside any one app.
specifics: Stores the reference, the dates and the promised outcome
Works from email rather than needing an integration
start.limitation: Parsing confirmation email reliably is the hard part, and it breaks whenever a template changes.

study.proposition: Does automated support resolve problems or defer them?
specifics: Classify reported outcomes by whether a person was ever reached
Compare deferral rates across problem types
study.limitation: Resolution is only visible to the platform, so this rests on what people report.

write.proposition: The chat window that freezes the phone you needed it on.
specifics: Open with someone stuck at an airport with a failing app
Use the reviews describing the error loop
write.limitation: Service failure is an old subject; the angle is support breaking in the same app as the problem.
